scope: Implementer review of full consumed requests, actual selected source contracts and retained traces; not independent fresh annotation

rows.semantic_review: Ordering and zero-based distinct positions are explicit. The parser wrongly treats either output order as uncertainty about indexing/output. Selected sorted/one-based source contradicts the request; no missing pair facet supplies authority for it.
Sorted input, one-based increasing positions and constant extra space are explicit. The gate has no pair contract; this is declaration coverage failure, not a missing request distinction.
Line topology, nonnegative cash, no adjacent selections and amount output are explicit. Existing sibling margin rejects before required-facet checking; the narrow declaration set also lacks houses.
Circular topology, nonnegative cash, no adjacent selections, lone-house behavior and amount output are explicit. Sibling margin blocks the selected correct source before the gate.

Buy once then sell later, or do nothing explicitly limits completed trades to at most one. The generic or suppression loses that bound. No fee is not explicit. A post-sale cooldown cannot change a one-trade answer, so requiring it independently would overconstrain this query. The new match remains source-suite evidence, not proof of full semantic completeness.

Unlimited trades, one-share capacity, same-day permission, no fees/waiting days and maximum total profit are explicit. The including-zero-if-no-trade qualifier does not make the objective uncertain; sentence-wide if suppression is wrong.

Maximize profit and return total profit after fees are explicit, along with unlimited trades, once-per-trade fee and no cooldown. Existing grammar misses the objective wording. Frozen numeric confidence separately blocks the source.
Unlimited trades, one-day cooldown, no fee and maximum profit are explicit. Selected no-cooldown source conflicts; this is not missing semantics.
Dependency direction, all-course completion and boolean output are explicit. The gate has no course contract. No relevant declared output fact is missing.

Dependency direction, full valid ordering and empty-list failure behavior are explicit. If-impossible fallback does not make the requested ordering uncertain. Gate declaration absent and numeric threshold also blocks.

The request asks for the count in the supplied map; character grid, four-neighbor connectivity and water boundary are explicit. No separate no-cell-changes phrase occurs, but the task does not authorize an edit operation. The current phrase schema cannot represent this task scope reliably; do not label its absent token alone as missing semantics.

Integer grid, four-neighbor area and empty-land zero are explicit. Largest connected patch differs from the selected bordered-square problem. The current schema also lacks a robust representation of measuring the given map without edits.
Distinct top-k by frequency, valid k, unique answer set and arbitrary output ordering are explicit. The narrow gate has no frequency contract.
Rank-th largest occurrence, batch input, valid one-based rank and no full sort are explicit and extracted. Required-facet check passes; numeric match threshold rejects.

Positive array/target, minimum contiguous length, at-least threshold, zero if absent and linear time are explicit. Return-length is wrongly suppressed by its failure-value if clause; reaches-or-exceeds is an inclusive comparison, not an unspecified objective.

Nonempty contiguous selection, possible negative values, maximum sum and mandatory nonempty choice are explicit. Gate has no window contract. Its small facet list also does not encode all these semantics.

unreviewed_semantics: Eight no-example controls stop before recognition; no semantic conclusion from that abstention
